forecaster_note: Wed: more S swell hanging around than forecast plus a bit of ENE — head high at S magnets, waist–chest elsewhere, clean AM with offshore WSW then junky onshore arvo. Thu: new mixed S swell fills in (head high). Fri: long-period S swell, plenty of size but straight. Sat: eases, chest–head at S magnets, breezy N. — Surfline forecaster, Wed 28 Oct

wind.summary: WSW/W 11 kph at 6am, ~14 kph 9am, ~21 kph noon — offshore all morning; swings cross/onshore SE ~3pm. Clear, 11°C rising to ~23°C.

shark.summary: No shark detections in the Palm Beach → Manly zone in the last 24h (last one: tagged white shark #3689 at Palm Beach receiver ~67h ago; latest drone sighting Newport ~7 days ago). Feed is current (newest statewide detection ~6 min ago); 62 real detections statewide in 24h (Birubi, Surf Beach, Yamba, Bennetts most active). DPI feed returned no features. Absence of detections is not a guarantee — check the live map before paddling out.

days.surfline_text: New mixed shorter and longer south swell is expected to fill in through the day. Should be head high or so, to maybe a bit bigger at the south exposed breaks. Small to fun size elsewhere if you want something easy going.  Clean to cleanish in the morning with light offshore to SW winds. Then more onshore the rest of the day.
